title: NEXT_WORK_UNIT_SELECTOR_AND_ROADMAP_GATE
source_of_truth: Repository/server state after ERA34 closure at 393a343e5c70c1b800ffcf04da1d4fe087c232a1
purpose: Select the next real Tokenoskobi work unit by evidence, dependency and risk/fayda scoring instead of ad hoc conversation choice.
scope: Control-plane selector only. No feature implementation. No CORE upgrade. No root artifact creation.
input_sources: existing backlog signals in runtime/history artifacts

dependency_ready_score.meaning: How ready the prerequisites are without opening CORE_UPGRADE.

risk_reduction_score.meaning: How much the work reduces real project risk or uncertainty.

strategic_value_score.meaning: How much the work moves Tokenoskobi toward its intelligence mission.

implementation_cost_score.meaning: Higher score means lower cost and less repo bloat.

runtime_safety_score.meaning: How safely the work can proceed with no wallet, no trade, no live execution.
